about_the_game:
Discover the enchanting world of Mysteries of Shaola: The Cave, where fantasy meets mystery in a fun adventure.

This isn't just another fantasy game – it combines the best of fantasy and mystery, immersing you in a world of wonder and discovery. It’s a heart-pounding journey that'll keep you guessing at every turn.

Ready to test your mettle? Your legend is just a download away. Grab the demo now and start your journey to becoming Shaola's greatest investigator, and take your first step into a world of wonder and danger.

In this demo and preview, you'll step into the role of the young master of the Rose Garden, a middle-tier mercenary faction in the Kazen Kingdom. Instead of being the main hero, you'll delve into the history of the Rose Garden and uncover the events of 18 years ago. After years of fleeing and hiding, your family finds refuge in a deadly and mysterious cave. Following a brutal massacre, you and your sister find yourselves at the cave entrance. Once you’ve completed the demo, you’ll be directed back to the main game store page on Steam, where you can purchase the full game to continue your journey.
